content: React 19 (released Dec 2024) removed UMD builds entirely per the official upgrade guide and PR #28735; the recommended script-tag path is an ESM CDN like esm.sh. Latest React is 19.3.0 (npm registry, 2026-09-11). React 18 final is 18.3.1 and its UMD builds are still served (unpkg HEAD 200 verified on react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js). For an app already on React 18 UMD, staying on 18.3.1 is the zero-risk path; moving to 19 requires switching to ESM loading.
